Q.name: Resonating Strike
Q.title: Template:Data Lee Sin/Resonating Strike
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Resonating Strike|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Lee Sin
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Resonating Strike.png
|pre-blurb = Lee Sin/Sonic Wave
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lee Sin}} {{tip|dashes}} to the nearby enemy marked by ''{{ai|Sonic Wave|Lee Sin}}'', consuming the mark upon arrival to deal {{as|physical damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lee Sin''' {{tip|dashes}} to the nearby enemy marked by ''{{ai|Sonic Wave|Lee Sin}}''. Upon arrival, he consumes the mark and deals {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{pp|key=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health|color=health}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|60*2 to 180*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description2 = ''The marked enemy must be within range in order to cast this ability. {{ai|Iron Will|Lee Sin}} and {{ai|Cripple|Lee Sin}} can be cast during the dash.''
|cost         = 25
|costtype     = Energy
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1250|Cast range}}
|speed        = {{tt|1350 + {{as|100% movement speed}}|Ideal; bugged at different distances}}
|cast time    = none
|targeting    = Proximity
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Spell
|grounded     = True
|callforhelp  = 
|knockdown    = True
|notes        =
* '''Lee Sin''' will track the target if they change locations.
** He will dash to the target's previous location without consuming the mark if the target is too far away or moves beyond 2000 units.
* '''Lee Sin''' will attempt to place himself on top of the target upon arrival.
** The damage dealt by ''Resonating Strike'' can be negated if the target {{tip|blink|blinks}}. Sometimes, '''Lee Sin''' will end the dash at their last location but appear on top of the target after a short delay.
** Originally, '''Lee Sin''' would land 50 units in front of his target. Since there are no patch notes where this is noted to have changed, landing on top of his target may be a bug.
* ''Resonating Strike'' cannot be cast without the marked target nearby or if the target is {{tip|untargetable}}.
* If ''Resonating Strike'' interrupts another dash, {{ai|Tempest|Lee Sin}} and {{ai|Dragon's Rage|Lee Sin}} can be cast during it (both otherwise cannot be cast).
{{ct|attack=false|move=false|cast=[[File: Safeguard.png|20px|link=]] ''Safeguard'', [[File: Iron Will.png|20px|link=]] ''Iron Will'', and [[File: Cripple.png|20px|link=]] ''Cripple'' can be cast. [[File: Tempest.png|20px|link=]] ''Tempest'' and [[File: Dragon's Rage.png|20px|link=]] ''Dragon's Rage'' are disabled.|items=true,,,interrupts|consume=true|spells=true,interrupts, true, false|interrupts=death}}
}}

W.name: Safeguard
W.title: Template:Data Lee Sin/Safeguard
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Safeguard|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Lee Sin |skill = W |icon = Safeguard.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lee Sin}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target allied unit. If the ally is a {{tip|champion}}, both they and '''Lee Sin''' gain a {{tip|shield}} for a short time upon his arrival and ''Safeguard's'' cooldown is {{sti|cdr|halved}}.
'''Lee Sin''' can [[self-targeted|self-cast]] ''Safeguard'' to shield himself. |blurb2 = After ''Safeguard'' is cast, '''Lee Sin''' can cast ''{{ai|Iron Will|Lee Sin}}'' within a short time. |post-blurb = Lee Sin/Iron Will |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lee Sin''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target allied unit's location. If the ally is a {{tip|champion}} upon arrival, both they and '''Lee Sin''' gain a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds.
If the target is a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|ward}}, '''Lee Sin''' also shields himself.
'''Lee Sin''' can [[self-targeted|self-cast]] ''Safeguard'' to shield himself. |leveling = {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|60 to 240}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}} |description2 = After ''Safeguard'' is cast, '''Lee Sin''' can cast ''{{ai|Iron Will|Lee Sin}}'' within the next 3 seconds. |description3 = ''{{ai|Iron Will|Lee Sin}} and {{ai|Cripple|Lee Sin}} can be cast during the dash.'' |cooldown = {{tt|7|Starts on first cast}} |cdstart = on-cast |cost = 50 |costtype = Energy |cast time = none |target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 700 |speed = 1350 + {{as|100% movement speed}} |targeting = Unit |grounded = True |knockdown = True |notes = * '''Lee Sin''' cannot self-cast ''Safeguard'' while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}. * ''Safeguard'' can be used on any targetable allied unit excluding [[structures]]. ** This includes {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|minions}}, {{tip|ward|wards}}, and [[champion summoned units]] (e.g. {{ai|Noxious Trap|Teemo}}, {{ai|Demacian Standard|Jarvan IV}}, {{ai|Dark Passage|Thresh}}). * If no unit is directly targeted, ''Safeguard'' will search for wards in a 100 radius to target. ** This aids '''Lee Sin''' in performing the dash to a ward he just placed. * ''Safeguard'' will not grant its {{tip|shield}} if the dash is interrupted. ** If the dash overrides or is overridden by {{ai|Resonating Strike|Lee Sin}}, he will grant the shield immediately rather than on arrival. * If ''Safeguard's'' dash interrupts another dash, {{ai|Tempest|Lee Sin}} and {{ai|Dragon's Rage|Lee Sin}} can be cast during it (both otherwise cannot be cast). }}
